sensitivity_design.per_draw: recompute v_b and S-eco on the draw's P1 plant; run B0 and B3 on S2, L-EVE, P1, for M0, M1
sensitivity_design.purpose: coverage of the declared reference-plant ranges for the H3 sensitivity criterion of protocol 8.1 (at least 29 of 32 draws with dE_rel <= -1.0 % and none > 0, for M0 and M1 separately)
sensitivity_design.interpretation: coverage design, not a probability statement; the spread is a sensitivity range, never a confidence interval (protocol 7.5)
sensitivity_design.gain: nominal P1 fixed LQR gain for every draw and both branches (AMB-14, owner decision 2026-10-28)
sensitivity_design.scope: robustness to plant-parameter uncertainty under a fixed controller; not retuned per draw

implemented_decisions.D2_p3_profiles: B0 tracks v_b designed on P1; B3 tracks S-eco designed on P1; both run on the P3 plant
implemented_decisions.D3_arrival_rule: arrival no later than the reference arrival, then at rest until the reference departure
implemented_decisions.D5_p3_infeasible_rule: run and retain both arms; classify the condition infeasible; no paired energy difference

numerical_checks.criterion: M0, M1: |e_dyn - e_QS| / e_QS <= 1 % for both arms, using only protocol-8.2-valid, recomputation-confirmed energy (AMB-31 ruling); M2 reported; QS-ineligible pairs are NOT_APPLICABLE_QS_INFEASIBLE (neither pass nor fail); a FAIL or NOT_EVALUABLE_* pair in any set, missing nominal evidence, or no PASS on the held-out nominal set NOM -> INCONCLUSIVE (AMB-29(b)-(d), AMB-30 rulings)
numerical_checks.on_fail: GO: that motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE (protocol 9)

numerical_checks.name: dynamic_time_step

amendment_2_implemented.N_A2_applicability: protocol 9 QS-vs-dynamic applies to a pair only if both the B0 and the B3 profile pass the QS feasibility screen (QSPlant.step) on the condition's evaluated plant
amendment_2_implemented.N_A2_applicable_failure: the M0/M1 motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE (protocol 9, unchanged)
amendment_2_implemented.N_A2_no_eligible_comparison: the M0/M1 motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE with respect to this criterion
amendment_2_implemented.N_A2_failed_check_record: every failing piece with its failed QSPlant.step sub-check(s) (drive torque, battery discriminant, discharge current) and their values at each Gauss node
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_29_profile_unavailable: owner ruling 2026-10-28: the condition keeps its explicit PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE or BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE status and counts in every planned-run, feasibility and verdict denominator; never COMPARABLE, never a paired comparison, never removed; only the pair's QS-vs-dynamic check is NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE (its applicability condition is objectively unmet), which is not a pass
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_29_eligible_run_missing: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(b)): NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING (class NOT_EVALUABLE) -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; the pair stays in every planned-run denominator and every available energy trace is kept for diagnostics
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_29_qs_energy_undefined: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(c)): QS energy per reference km <= 0 -> NOT_EVALUABLE_QS_UNDEFINED -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; the raw values and the exact non-positive term are recorded; no percentage, replacement denominator, epsilon, absolute value or substitute threshold; the runs' dynamic result is unaffected and protocol 8.2 still applies to it. Reading I-5 (amendment 2 section 9): the owner's QS_COMPARISON_NOT_EVALUABLE is the NOT_EVALUABLE class
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_29_condition_error: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(d)): an exception before or during the pair evaluation, including the QS screen -> NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITION_ERROR (eligibility unknown; NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE if a profile is missing) -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; both dynamic arms still run and are classified by protocol 8.2 alone; the error, traceback, traces and run IDs are kept (errors.csv, conditions/, traces/); no retry, automatic replacement or substitute run; a rerun only under the protocol and an explicitly authorised procedure with a distinct run ID. Reading I-6 (amendment 2 section 9): an exception inside one run makes the condition ERROR and leaves a QS-eligible pair NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING unless a valid arm FAILs
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_30_branch_scope: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (strict): an applicable FAIL or a NOT_EVALUABLE_* pair in any preregistered set (NOM, P3, INS, CNV, SEN) makes the M0/M1 branch INCONCLUSIVE, counted per set, never averaged; a required PASS must come from the held-out nominal S2 set NOM; a PASS in another set, the in-sample S1 set INS included, never substitutes; missing held-out nominal evidence blocks PASS. Readings (amendment 2 section 9, confirmed only by approving the amendment): I-1 the required PASS is at least one of the motor's two NOM cells, and a NOM cell that is NOT_APPLICABLE_QS_INFEASIBLE is not missing evidence; I-2 a NOM cell that is absent, duplicated, not evaluable, or whose condition has no profile lacks evidence; a planned pair missing from the record blocks PASS
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_31_energy_of_invalid_runs: owner ruling 2026-10-28: energy of a run failing protocol 8.2, or not confirmed by its recomputation, is diagnostic only (energy_roles.csv DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_*): never confirmatory, never credited to the paired endpoint, never used by the QS-vs-dynamic check. Reading I-4 (amendment 2 section 9): both the in-process and the separate recomputation must confirm the run
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_31_invalid_arm_label: NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_INVALID (owner ruling AMB-29(b): M0/M1 branch INCONCLUSIVE; M2 stays reported only)
amendment_2_implemented.paired_endpoint_rule: a paired energy comparison exists only for a condition whose final status is COMPARABLE: both arms complete the task and pass every protocol 8.2 criterion and the separate recomputation
amendment_2_implemented.h3_verdict_denominators: fixed by protocol 8.1: 6 nominal S2 P1 cells and 32 draws per M0/M1; a missing, profile-failed, invalid or non-comparable cell or draw is never removed and never counts toward SUPPORTED
amendment_2_implemented.AMB_32_not_supported_needs_all_nominal_c: owner ruling 2026-10-28: NOT SUPPORTED requires a comparable pair in all six nominal cells; a nominal cell that is missing, invalid or not evaluable makes the H3 verdict INCONCLUSIVE, recorded with its reason; no negative finding is inferred from missing data
amendment_2_implemented.non_positive_denominator_rule: AMB-29(c) ruling for the QS-vs-dynamic ratio (e_QS), and reading I-3 (amendment 2 section 9) for the other relative saving percentages (paired dE_rel, B0 energy per reference km; planner S_found, S_max and grid dS, E(v_b)): none is computed with a denominator <= 0 or not finite; the value is not evaluable and the exact term and the raw values are recorded. The recomputation and shortfall tolerance comparisons of amendment 1 are not saving percentages and are unchanged
amendment_2_implemented.record_invariant: every scheduled condition and run has exactly one record (no drop, retry or replacement); a violation is recorded in errors.csv and the manifest
amendment_2_implemented.separate_recomputation_exit_codes: 0 every recomputed run passes; 1 a run fails a protocol check; 3 independence violation or refusal; 4 exception. Only 0 and 1 are results: any other exit leaves every run unconfirmed and is recorded in errors.csv with its stderr; a fold that raises leaves no condition COMPARABLE

M1.validity_limits: Package template, not a measurement; NOT a Renault Zoe map and NOT the KT-01 motor

M2.label: M2 copper-loss stress model L = k_c T^2, k_c = 18000 (1/0.874 - 1) / 85^2
M2.assumptions: All loss as copper loss; charges stall loss at standstill
M2.validity_limits: Deliberately favourable to torque smoothing; QS energy not representative; dynamic results only
